Code Commandments — a compiler for architecture.

Usage:
  commandments <command> [options]

Commands:
  widget  Tend the widgets — every one of them, in the order they were made, with a summary long
          enough to wrap past the width.

Hooks (wired automatically — you rarely run these by hand):
  bare  Nothing else.

Global options:
  --help, -h      show this help — or, after a verb, that command's own usage
  --memory=LIMIT  memory ceiling for the run (default: 2G; -1 for no limit)
  --version       print the installed version of code-commandments

Run `commandments <command> --help` for a command's forms, options and notes.
